cover_letter.greeting: Dear Piper Sandler Debt Capital Markets Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Investment Banking Analyst role in Debt Capital Markets at Piper Sandler in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested in Piper Sandler because of its sector depth and the close-knit team culture the posting describes.

In my MBA coursework I valued J.M. Smucker with comps, built a DCF matched against a sell-side model, and built an LBO for the same company using Capital IQ. Before that, at Lenovo, I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis over 80%+ of inflows.
I don't have live deal experience, but I have the modeling training and the finance operations background, and I learn fast. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I'm applying for the IB Analyst role in Debt Capital Markets at Piper Sandler. I've built DCF and LBO models for J.M. Smucker in my coursework, and at Lenovo I built forecasts that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I'd love to hear what the DCM team looks for. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
